---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem this solves

What you're trying to accomplish and why the current behavior falls short. Concrete scenarios are more useful than abstract complaints.

## Proposed solution

How you'd like it to work. A rough UI sketch, example filter DSL, or sample JSON shape is welcome but not required.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out. If there's an existing workaround, mention it here.

## Additional context

Links to similar features in other tools (Todoist, TickTick, Things, etc.), related issues, platform considerations (does this need to work on Android / WASM?), or constraints that affect the design.
